desc: The Midwest Industries MP5/MP5K M-LOK Suppressor Handguards are precision-machined, lightweight handguards designed to enhance the performance and versatility of your MP5 or MP5K. Featuring durable 6061 aluminum construction and a hard coat anodized finish, these handguards provide a sleek, low-profile fit that accommodates suppressors and accessories. The M-LOK slots offer modular mounting options for lights, grips, and other attachments, ensuring optimal customization for tactical applications. Easy to install, these handguards are engineered for a secure, rock-solid fit without the need for permanent modification. Proudly made in the USA, they are a top-tier upgrade for your firearm.
